title: Colonization for Windows savegame
description: The decoded form of a COLONIZE .SAV file. Derived from the 57 write calls in save_game_to_file_1008_a7f6 and cross-checked against load_saved_game_1008_9056. GENERATED by src/schema/generate.ts -- do not edit by hand.

formatVersion.description: Version of THIS JSON model, not of the save file.

eofMarker.description: DOS end-of-file byte, 0x1a. Part of the magic as far as the loader is concerned.

version.description: Save version. The game accepts only 0x49.

mapWidth.description: Map columns. 58 in both known saves. Sets each map plane to width*height bytes.

mapHeight.description: Map rows. 72 in both known saves.

map.description: Four planes of width*height bytes. Plane 0 is terrain (low 5 bits = id, bit 5 hilly, bit 6 river); plane 2 carries a nation index in its high nibble; plane 1 is a bitfield holding roads and plowing. Plane 3 is unidentified.

state.description: The top-level fields that are not records or map planes, in file order.

fleetStrength.description: write 22 | 8 bytes | SEG20:0xd9d6, four words, one per European power.

tribeStrength.description: write 37 | 8 bytes | SEG20:0xdc00, one byte per tribe.

tribePop.description: write 38 | 8 bytes | SEG20:0xdc08, one byte per tribe.

tribeSettlementCount.description: write 39 | 8 bytes | SEG20:0xdc10, one byte per tribe.

uninitialisedStack.description: write 54 | 4 bytes | A SHIPPED BUG. These four bytes come from a stack local the saver never assigns: it is passed through an identity function, written, passed through again, and that is its whole life. Every save carries whatever happened to be on the stack, so two saves of the same game never compare equal. The loader reads them into a local of its own and discards them. Carried verbatim; never compare two saves on this field.

routes.description: write 57 | 888 bytes | SEG20:0xc804, 888 bytes. All zero in AUTO01.SAV -- it was long mistaken for end-of-file padding, and its start offset falling exactly out of the write arithmetic is what proved the 57-field chain correct.

Globals.title: Globals
Globals.description: The game-state globals block, a raw dump of SEG20:0x7782..0x780f. 142 bytes.

gameFlags.description: +0x02 | 2B | confidence: high | SEG20:0x7784. See GAME_FLAGS / win-decomp include/gameflag.h: 0x1 independence declared, 0x8 revolution won, 0x40 war begun.

scenarioFlags.description: +0x06 | 2B | confidence: medium | SEG20:0x7788. NOT byte-swapped by globals_swap_words -- the only word-aligned gap in the pass.

year.description: +0x0a | 2B | confidence: high | SEG20:0x778c. 1492 + turnCounter in both sample saves.

playerNation.description: +0x18 | 2B | confidence: high | values: NATION | SEG20:0x779a. Which of the four powers you are.

settlementCount.description: +0x1a | 2B | confidence: high | SEG20:0x779c. Length of the 18-byte array. CHANGING THIS CHANGES THE FILE SIZE.

unitCount.description: +0x1c | 2B | confidence: high | SEG20:0x779e. Length of the 28-byte array. Capped at 300 by the game.

colonyCount.description: +0x1e | 2B | confidence: high | SEG20:0x77a0. Length of the 202-byte array. Capped at 48 by the game.

revealAll.description: +0x22 | 2B | confidence: high | SEG20:0x77a4. The map-reveal cheat.

difficulty.description: +0x26 | 1B | confidence: high | values: DIFFICULTY | SEG20:0x77a8. 0 Discoverer .. 4 Viceroy.

warStarted.description: +0x48 | 8B | confidence: medium | SEG20:0x77ca, one per European power.

royalForces.description: +0x5a | 8B | confidence: high | SEG20:0x77dc. The King’s expeditionary force, multiplied by eight once the war begins.

Block52.title: Block52
Block52.description: One of four 52-byte records from SEG20:0x7810. Contents unidentified. 52 bytes.

Rec6.title: Rec6
Rec6.description: One of four 6-byte records from SEG20:0x78e0. Contents unidentified. 6 bytes.

Colony.title: Colony
Colony.description: One colony. Array length is header.globals.colonyCount. 202 bytes.

name$tail.description: Non-zero bytes after the string terminator, if any.

aiState.description: +0x1b | 1B | confidence: medium | The AI's working byte; see win-decomp include/aicol.h.

flags.description: +0x1c | 1B | confidence: high | Notification latches AND live economy state; see win-decomp include/colflag.h. Bits 0x02/0x04 are the Sons-of-Liberty production bonus.

jobs.description: +0x20 | 32B | confidence: high | Per-colonist job, 32 slots; see JOBS. Ids below JOB_COLONIST are a building or tile reward.

spec.description: +0x40 | 32B | confidence: high | Per-colonist specialty, same id space as `jobs`.

specnib.description: +0x60 | 16B | confidence: medium | Sixteen bytes read as nibble pairs by 16 witnesses; what they hold is not established.

slots.description: +0x70 | 20B | confidence: high | Twenty tile/building work slots.

flags2.description: +0x84 | 12B | confidence: unknown | A 12-byte region, +0x84..+0x8f. Witnesses subdivide it inconsistently (one reads +0x8d as export_goods); the byte-swap pass proves only that none of it is a word.

item.description: +0x94 | 1B | confidence: medium | What the colony is currently building.

stock.description: +0x9a | 32B | confidence: high | values: GOODS | Warehouse contents, indexed by goods id. Sixteen words -- the count comes from the byte-swap pass, not from a declaration.

bells.description: +0xc2 | 4B | confidence: high | Liberty bells accumulated. The five witnesses that read BOTH longs put bells here and the cap at +0xc6; the 19 that name +0xc6 `bells` never saw this one.

Unit.title: Unit
Unit.description: One unit. Array length is header.globals.unitCount. 28 bytes.

type.description: +0x02 | 1B | confidence: high | Index into the 14-byte unit-type table at SEG20:0x7ac8.

flags.description: +0x03 | 1B | confidence: high | LOW NIBBLE is the owning nation (0..11, see NATION); the HIGH nibble is a flag set -- it takes only 0/1/2/4/8, which is what unit_nation_flag_set writing 0x10 << n produces.

f05.description: +0x05 | 1B | confidence: unknown | Read as `moves` by 5 witnesses; not established.

f06.description: +0x06 | 1B | confidence: unknown | Read as a home-settlement index by a few witnesses; native_settlement_delete fixes this field up when a settlement dies, which supports it.

cargo.description: +0x0d | 10B | confidence: medium | The cargo hold, +0x0d..+0x16. HOW IT SPLITS IS CONTESTED: one reconstruction declares cargo[3] then amount[7], another a single cargo[10]. Kept as one run until the split is settled.

spec.description: +0x17 | 1B | confidence: medium | Profession/specialty (see JOBS) by 52 witnesses; 28 others call it `route`.

link.description: +0x18 | 2B | confidence: high | Stack chain. -1 in every record of both sample saves.

link2.description: +0x1a | 2B | confidence: high | Second stack chain. -1 in every record of both sample saves.

Nation.title: Nation
Nation.description: One European power. Always exactly four, indexed 0..3 (see NATION). 316 bytes.

tax.description: +0x01 | 1B | confidence: high | Tax rate, per cent.

recruit.description: +0x02 | 3B | confidence: high | The three colonists waiting on the Europe docks; JOBS ids.

bells.description: +0x0c | 2B | confidence: high | Liberty bells toward the next founding father. `add_liberty` adds to this and to +0x0e both.

nextFather.description: +0x12 | 2B | confidence: medium | The father currently being recruited; see FATHERS.

fathers.description: +0x14 | 2B | confidence: medium | Start of the founding-father bitset read by `nation_flag_test` -- father id IS the bit number. A BYTE field: the swap pass does not touch it, so it is not a word. How far the bitset runs past +0x15 is not established (25 fathers need 4 bytes).

boycott.description: +0x20 | 2B | confidence: high | Bitmask of boycotted goods, one bit per GOODS id.

kingChest.description: +0x22 | 4B | confidence: high | The KING's balance for this nation: tax paid in, (difficulty*8+10) a turn, minus 1800 per regular/cavalry/gun he buys.

netSaleRevenue.description: +0x26 | 4B | confidence: high | Cumulative net sale revenue. Written every turn and never read.

gold.description: +0x2a | 4B | confidence: high | YOUR GOLD. `nation_add_gold` clamps it to 0..999,999.

crosses.description: +0x2e | 2B | confidence: high | Crosses toward the next immigrant -- NOT bells. Zeroed when it passes `crossesNeeded`.

rel.description: +0x34 | 4B | confidence: medium | Relations with the other European powers.

f49.description: +0x49 | 1B | confidence: unknown | Read as `muskets` and as `rebel` by one witness each.

f4a.description: +0x4a | 2B | confidence: unknown | Read as `horses` by one witness.

price.description: +0x4c | 16B | confidence: high | values: GOODS | Europe market price per goods id.

volume.description: +0x5c | 32B | confidence: medium | values: GOODS | Per-goods market volume / price drift.
